# Cohort 75: native refusal and duplicate construction

Five remaining SQL-free publication/refusal workloads now consume the existing
native PostgreSQL construction recipe instead of borrowing pools and expanding
them into selected stores. No helper, callback, event, lifecycle transition,
subscription, prepared capability, result, readback or temporal cut changes.
The selected-fork rejection still proves missing-source rollback, no event,
no dispatch and no provider reachability; it is not a successful-fork proof.

The finite whole-function oracle permits only the exact construction/close-owner
replacement and compares every original assertion. Focused native race execution
includes the five touched roots plus the three unchanged SQLite terminal,
diagnostic and duplicate siblings. All three publication forms, active/terminal
duplicate phases and both zero-route backend cells remain exercised.

No SQL getter, reconstruction, new owner, framework, override or compatibility
path is added. Original native fixture cleanup owns close. Existing raw_sql_policy
and approved broad #2542 gate bind this routine consumer migration; no production
semantic/spec change or new tracking decision. Parent completion remains open.
